item.title: East Las Vegas valley intersection to close for 27 hours for roadwork
item.description: A 27-hour closure of an east Las Vegas valley intersection is set to take place over the weekend, according to Clark County.

item.title: 'They will kill your 3-year-old': Family reacts to deadly Las Vegas police shooting
item.description: The family of a 3-year-old boy who died Tuesday morning is pushing back against the Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department's description of what transpired when officers shot at the child's father, killing him.

item.title: Las Vegas Metro police to join forces for impaired driver campaign
item.description: The Las Vegas Metropolitan Police Department is set to join forces with Nevada law enforcement agencies for a Joining Forces Impaired Driver Campaign.

item.title: Nye County former GOP leader arrested on child porn charges
item.description: Bill Carns, former chairman of the Nye County Republican Central Committee, was arrested on Saturday, January 31st.

item.title: Las Vegas area police cite 50,000 drivers for registration violations in 2025
item.description: Records 8 News Now obtained show police departments in the Las Vegas region cited more than 50,000 drivers for registration-related violations in 2025.

item.title: Fatal Las Vegas police shooting of man, toddler will haunt first responders, expert says
item.description: The minute or so it took for police to shoot a man holding a 3-year-old boy - resulting in the death of that man and the toddler - will forever haunt the police officers involved, 911 operators who fielded phone calls and paramedics who treated the victim, an attorney and self-described "unapologetic advocate for law enforcement and first responders" told the 8 News Now Investigators.

item.title: Las Vegas patients notified after FDA flags mammogram failures at Summerlin Hospital
item.description: Patients who received a mammogram at Summerlin Hospital Medical Center over the past two years were informed of a failure, the 8 News Now Investigators have learned.

item.title: Super Bowl spending in Nevada projected to reach $199.7M
item.description: Over 2 million Nevadans are expected to watch the Big Game on Sunday and Super Bowl spending across the state is projected to reach an all-time high, according to the Retail Association of Nevada (RAN).

item.title: Several fall 'deathly ill' from Las Vegas bio lab; tip leads FBI, police to garage that smelled like 'hospital'
item.description: Several people became sick from an illegal bio lab running out of a Las Vegas home that also served as an Airbnb, according to documents the 8 News Now Investigators obtained Tuesday.
